name: web-social-media-ribbon-banner-infographic-with-laptop-and-quote-marks
title: 'Social Media' concept illustration with a teal ribbon banner, giant quote marks and a laptop hub icon
whatItIs: A white illustration with a teal ribbon banner reading 'SOCIAL MEDIA', a central laptop icon with browser chrome, giant black quote marks flanking it, and three numbered labels (Share, Like, Chat) each with a small icon, connected to the laptop by dotted lines.
whatItMeans: Clear and iconic; a central device hub with radiating labelled actions makes an abstract concept like 'social media' easy to diagram.
techniques: Use a ribbon banner shape for a classic infographic title.
Radiate labelled actions from a central device icon.
Use oversized quote marks as a nod to conversation and sharing.

vocabulary.definition: A title shape with folded, flag-like ends.
A layout radiating related items from one central element.
